status: CANDIDATE. Not frozen. Extends, and does not replace, the successor candidate requirements-compiled/v4.1.5 (ODR-V415-01 A and ODR-V415-IF-VIEW A recorded; ODR-V415-02 package approval pending) and causa-storage v1.0.0. Entities marked proposed depend on OD-CR-01.

authorities.storage: kemiller2002/causa-data@e8259df74add723765c57a5b1a5888d9c3f707af contract/v1.0.0 (causa-storage v1.0.0): wire shapes, canonical form, event registry, projection
authorities.domainTypes: requirements-compiled/v4.1.5/contracts (CANDIDATE successor of frozen v4.1.4): F# case names, envelope, persistence and UI boundary types

principles: Every stored fact is an immutable event (CONTRACT §5.5). An edit is a new event; the earlier value stays in history. Assessments are revised by new events, never by rewriting old ones.

Evidence is the admitted original content (EvidenceAdmitted.content, verbatim, immutable). Interpretations of evidence are separate records with their own identity: relationships (EvidenceRelated, with rationale), verification assessments, hypothesis transitions (with reason and cited evidence), findings and conclusions.
No field has an invented default. Where the wire requires a value the requirements give no input for, the contract names the gap and an owner decision (OD-CR-*); it does not pick a value.
Unknown fields and unknown event types are refused, never dropped (CONTRACT §2.4, §7.1, §13.5).

entities.name: Workspace
entities.serialization: directory workspaces/demo/<runId>/ (CONTRACT §3); runId ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$; a catalog workspace comes from catalog/active.json; a working copy is only workspaces/demo/causa-app-<run>
entities.modification: none; investigations are added under it
entities.historicalCompatibility: historical-v1 and demonstration-v1 hold the same three cases byte-identically; addressing is by (workspace, id) (InvestigationRef)

entities.name: Investigation
entities.modification: lifecycle only in v1.0.0 (DM-INVESTIGATION); details editing is proposed (InvestigationDetailsRevised)
entities.relationships: owns every other record of its history
entities.historicalCompatibility: all four catalog cases replay to their manifest lifecycle

entities.name: Investigation details revision (question, edited title and problem statement)
entities.creation: with StartInvestigation when a question is entered (same command group)
entities.modification: each edit appends one event; the projection shows the latest; the original problem statement (INV-008) stays InvestigationStarted.original
entities.historicalCompatibility: absent from all historical data; nothing is fabricated for historical cases (OD-HC-06 B)

entities.name: Hypothesis
entities.fsharpType: Causa.Domain.Hypothesis; HypothesisTransition (opaque; exactly the wire fields)
entities.serialization: HypothesisRecorded + HypothesisTransitioned; projection Entity.hypothesis with history
entities.modification: DM-HYPOTHESIS transitions; text edit is proposed HypothesisRevised
entities.relationships: cited evidence ids must exist (admissibility, OD-HC-03 A)

entities.name: Evidence
entities.fsharpType: Causa.Domain.Evidence; EvidenceSupersession (opaque; exactly the wire fields)
entities.modification: content: supersession to a new id only; descriptive metadata: proposed EvidenceRevised
entities.relationships: relationships, verification assessments and hypothesis transitions refer to it by id
entities.application: OD-CR-02 A, OD-CR-03 A recorded; pending the catalog amendment (INV-045 required category; INV-028 required)

entities.name: Evidence source
entities.fsharpType: part of Evidence (source text); catalog provenance record (off-stream)
entities.serialization: EvidenceAdmitted.source (required non-blank text). Historical cases also carry catalog/historical-v1/provenance/<case>.json records (claimId, sourceId, url, title, locator), outside the event stream
entities.historicalCompatibility: every historical provenance URL occurs in its evidence's source text (validator CR-HIST-PROVENANCE)

entities.name: Hypothesis-evidence relationship

allowedValues.historical display: the wire kind verbatim as a read-only label (OD-HC-07 B); insufficient is never shown as inconclusive

entities.creation: RelateEvidence; one current assessment per pair; rationale required at the command boundary (INV-038)
entities.historicalCompatibility: 186 historical relationships, all with a rationale; 9 use insufficient

entities.name: Assessment
entities.serialization: EvidenceVerificationAssessed (evidence verification status); HypothesisTransitioned (hypothesis assessment with reason and cited evidence); EvidenceRelated (evidence-to-hypothesis assessment)
entities.modification: a later assessment event supersedes the current one in the projection; nothing is rewritten
entities.historicalCompatibility: 376 EvidenceVerificationAssessed events, absent from frozen v4.1.4 and added by v4.1.5 E1

entities.name: Conclusion
entities.creation: RecordConclusion (proposed CoreCommand case: v4.1.5 has the event but no command)
entities.modification: a new conclusion is a new snapshot (INV-032); it does not resolve the investigation
entities.application: OD-CR-01 A, OD-CR-04 A recorded; pending RecordConclusion in v4.1.6 and the catalog amendment (INV-046 required strength)

entities.name: Decision (kernel decision on a command)
entities.fsharpType: Causa.Domain.Decision = Allowed | Blocked | RequiresReview | UnsupportedSemantics | Conflict | Duplicate
entities.serialization: not persisted: only Allowed events are written. No requirement or historical record defines a persisted 'decision' entity; cause confirmation (CausalAssertionConfirmed) and proposal acceptance/rejection are the persisted decisions of the domain.

entities.name: Investigation history
entities.serialization: events.ndjson, one RFC 8785 canonical envelope per LF-terminated line; aggregateVersion 1..N; eventId = UUIDv5(N, investigationId/version/correlationId)
entities.historicalCompatibility: every pinned history decodes and re-encodes byte for byte (CR-HIST-ROUNDTRIP)

entities.name: Provenance
entities.fsharpType: EventProvenance (v4.1.5 E1: occurredAt, actor, correlationId, formatVersion, semanticVersion)
entities.serialization: envelope occurredAt, actor {actorId, kind[, provider, model]}, correlationId; projection Def.provenance {actor, recordedAt}
entities.historicalCompatibility: frozen v4.1.4 drops it from all events; v4.1.5 carries it. UI writes use the fixed actor {actorId: causa-operator, kind: human} (OD-CR-07 A)

entities.name: Persistence metadata
entities.serialization: manifest.json (no provider metadata: no git SHA, branch, path or token) + snapshot.json; commit and blob identity live only in the persistence layer
entities.modification: rewritten with each append (derived files); events.ndjson only grows
entities.historicalCompatibility: every pinned manifest and snapshot decodes and round-trips

proposedStorageExtension.name: causa-storage 1.1.0 (compatible additive extension, CONTRACT §13.1)
proposedStorageExtension.authority: ODR-R10-26 A (recorded, APR-R10-OWNER-3): 'causa-data storage contract v1.1 adds them (the causa-data owner's decision)'. This is the content proposed for that release; it is not released.
rules: Only new event types and new enum values: no v1.0.0 event changes, so every v1.0.0 history reads unchanged under 1.1.0 and a v1.0.0 reader refuses 1.1.0 data (fail closed, §13.2).
Written only into new working-copy workspaces; never into a v1.0.0 investigation in place (§13.2).
Each proposed event gets a successor CoreEvent case of the same name and a CoreCommand case (v4.1.6 successor package through requirements-compiler X01-X21, independent review and owner freeze).
